sources.wikimedia_commons: per-file licence from Commons extmetadata; CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA approved when author + licence URL are stated
sources.provider_artwork: not used: no provider image licence permits our use (ESPN headshots are never guessed or hotlinked)

player_identity: Wikidata item via exact ESPN FC player id (P3681); birth date must not contradict
team_identity: Wikidata club via roster proof (>=60% and >=5 id-matched players share the current club, runner-up <=30%, unique)
crest_trademark_note: Free-licensed Commons crests are approved and used only to identify the club; set to "review" to hold every trademarked crest for owner review.
